title: Carving a Pumpkin the Size of a Pea
altTitles: The Smallest Jack-o'-Lantern in Thimble Town
description: Bramble carves a pumpkin the size of a pea in Thimble Town. #miniature #asmr #pumpkin
topic: Pea-sized pumpkin carving cut-ASMR short (text-label arm)

sections.label: Crunch → it's a pea
sections.videoPrompt:
Continuous single shot inside a miniature diorama, tilt-shift macro, shallow depth
of field. Camera: slow pull-back, constant speed, no cuts. The knife point crunches into the skin; the camera pulls back to reveal the pea-sized pumpkin beside a needle and a pencil tip, and Bramble carving, small toy-like movements.
Ambient motion: a bead of pumpkin juice on the blade. Lighting stays golden hour. Warm cozy palette, fine film grain.

SB: pumpkin stays pea-sized relative to the needle eye (~1.5× the eye length) every beat; face design identical to LF4's (pumpkin face ref); knife never human-scale; carved face symmetrical and consistent through Beat 4; loop point (Beat 5 end = Beat 1 keyframe) no morph or luminance jump; label 'tiny pumpkin' is the only on-screen text (0:00–0:02).
